entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: An Art Deco metropolis of grit and glamour, built by angels and now ruled by five demon-led crime families.

entities.name: Crime families
entities.description: The five demon-led crime families battling for supremacy in New Capenna, bound by fragile alliances.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A precious commodity that seems to be running out.

entities.name: The Adversary
entities.description: Someone who makes a power grab in New Capenna.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives in New Capenna to investigate her past.

events.summary: The fragile alliances between the crime families strain toward breaking as halo runs out and the Adversary makes a power grab.
events.quote: The fragile alliances that foster peace between the families are being strained to a breaking point as the precious commodity halo seems to be running out

events.summary: Elspeth Tirel arrives in New Capenna to investigate her past.
